Do not invent requirements or change approved inputs/interfaces.

ticket-01-spec.assignment.json.instructions: Review the exact revision against the approved ticket/spec and actual check results. Do not edit source. Return findings classified as blocking or optional. For unavailable requirements or changes to approved contracts, return a blocking finding with human_decision_needed true. Identify the approved contract in requirement, supporting evidence/consequence, and the precise decision in resolution. Do not resolve the conflict by changing approved inputs or interfaces.
